items.title: The fundamental class of a nonempty smooth projective scheme and vanishing for the empty scheme

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the cohomology of the empty scheme vanishes and that for a nonempty smooth projective scheme the fundamental class is one and the unit is nonzero (statement lines 2799-2806). The proof (proof lines 2807-2845) computes the fundamental class by pullback, produces a nonzero class from a closed point with separable residue field, and eliminates the alternative for the empty scheme by a product argument. H3: two cases with an explicit nonzero class computation, written out in full.
